chunks: And by this chain, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadala ibn Ayyub, from Husayn ibn 'Uthman, from Sama'a ibn Mihran, from Abu Basir, who said: Abu 'Abd Allah (peace be upon him) said:
If you have urinated and forgotten to wash your penis until you have prayed, then you must repeat the wudu and wash your penis.

This means: when he had not yet performed wudu. As for when he has performed wudu and forgot to wash the member only — nothing more — then he is not required to repeat the wudu; rather, he is only required to wash the affected area. And what indicates this [follows].

key_terms.الْمَوْضِعِ: the place, the specific spot [requiring washing]
key_terms.ذَكَرَكَ: your penis, the male organ [requiring post-urination washing]

ai.seo_question: What must a person do if they forgot to wash their penis after urinating and then prayed, according to Imam al-Sadiq (AS) in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS), narrated through Abu Basir, rules that if a person urinated and forgot to wash the penis before praying, they must repeat the wudu and wash the organ. Shaykh al-Tusi appends a crucial juristic distinction: this ruling applies only when wudu had not yet been performed at all; if wudu was already completed and only the washing of the member was forgotten, then repeating the wudu is not required — washing that spot alone suffices.
